problem_description: Origin-Destination Integer Multicommodity Flow (ODIMCF). Each commodity must be routed on exactly one path from origin to destination, or rejected via an artificial arc. Minimize total cost of rejected commodities (artificial arc costs).

formulation_notes.arc_costs: All original arcs have cost 0. Artificial arcs have cost equal to commodity revenue.
formulation_notes.capacity_constraints: Sum of demands of commodities using each arc <= arc capacity.
formulation_notes.flow_constraints: Each commodity assigned to exactly one path or rejected (artificial arc).
